technical_awareness: Goal: prepare Qwen to operate a fixed, isolated Windows-installer baseline through the existing ACI. Inspection found Wine 9.0, winetricks, Bottles, Steam and bubblewrap installed. No matching 7-Zip installer was found within two levels of /home/jd/Downloads. The existing game_install skill launches an interactive installer in an existing Bottles environment; it does not provide the requested silent disposable-prefix test. RecoverySupervisor has no Windows-install tool. Previous Qwen lesson save/readback succeeded, but that was guided tool syntax, not demonstrated autonomous installation. Gemma fabricated receipts and is not cleared for execution by this curriculum.

prerequisites: An authorized Qwen assignment through the existing dispatcher. The tool allowlist is enforced by the backend and cannot be expanded by this curriculum.

Before a real install, obtain an operator-approved installer from its official source, record its exact version and SHA-256, and establish trust independently of a digest calculated from the same unverified download.

Provide a backend-owned disposable workspace with verified filesystem and network isolation. WINEPREFIX alone is not isolation: Wine can expose host paths. Do not reuse the live Fridays bottle or share the host display for a silent test.
The new fixed-purpose installer capability must pass regression tests before registration and execution. Its existence must be demonstrated, not inferred from this payload.
procedure: Authorized SKILL Commands for the recovery teaching exercise: SKILL recovery lesson_read compatibility-baseline-qwen; SKILL recovery lesson_save <one-line JSON with exactly id, version, content>; SKILL recovery lesson_read compatibility-install-plan-qwen. Only use commands present in the task allowlist.
Retrieve the previous lesson through the actual backend. Then teach back why successful guided lesson retrieval does not establish general ACI or Windows installation competence.

Create a concise implementation handoff rather than executable code. Identify the existing interactive Bottles path in fridays/game_installer.py and the fixed recovery contracts in core/recovery_supervisor.py as distinct from the absent silent installer capability. Do not invoke a nonexistent installer tool.

Specify one backend-owned installer identity and fixed argv. For the official 7-Zip EXE, verify the selected release's silent-switch documentation rather than extrapolating from MSI syntax. Reject arbitrary executables, shell syntax, extra switches, paths and environment overrides.

Require network-disabled execution after approved artifact acquisition; read-only access to the verified installer and system runtime; writes only to dedicated experiment state; no host home, runtime socket, GPU or display access for this silent test. Validate the Wine runtime's required files and initialization in isolation; never fall back to host execution.

Separate prefix initialization, installer exit, expected installed-file verification and cleanup results. Do not launch the installed application in this phase. A zero installer exit without expected files is a failed acceptance check.

Specify 120 seconds maximum for the installer, bounded prefix initialization, 30 minutes overall, 32 MiB combined output, verified 16 GiB RAM ceiling and an explicit disk budget before execution. Continuously drain bounded output and terminate the full experiment lifecycle on timeout. Preserve the exact exit/signal and timeout classification.

Keep Qwen as the candidate operator for this exercise, not as an automatically privileged role. Do not change Gemma's live permissions. A future Gemma stop-sequence experiment must show exact backend support, a complete tool request, no fabricated observation, and correct control transfer. Never use a generic JSON bracket as a stop string because it can truncate valid arguments.

Define regression cases for denied tool, malformed proposal, wrong installer digest, out-of-scope prefix, Wine unavailable in the sandbox, timeout, flooded output, installer zero with missing files, installer failure and cleanup with retained evidence. Unsupported sandbox capability must fail closed.

Save your own concise handoff using lesson_save with id compatibility-install-plan-qwen, version 1.0.0 and content at most 8000 characters. Then read it back. If a lesson already exists, retrieve it instead of overwriting. End with actual receipt identifiers, observed blockers and acceptance requirements.

Only after implementation and sandbox validation through the authorized local development workflow may the operator assignment request one real install. Record installer provenance, backend authorization, exact arguments, effective isolation controls, installer outcome and independent file checks. Do not mark installation or general Windows compatibility proven from this planning exercise.
capability_pack.failure_conditions: Stop on absent installer, unsupported sandbox, missing registered tool, unverified provenance, scope violation, approval denial, timeout or exceeded resource budgets. No package downloads, installation, real game launch, runtime-policy changes or source edits are authorized by the teaching exercise. Never bypass the ACI with shell execution. Report this phase as planning/teaching unless actual installation receipts exist. Never equate parsed JSON, a guided command, an exit code or a model assertion with full installation competence.
